Done! All three functions are now implemented and exported:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches from `${baseUrl}/api/users`, parses the JSON array, logs the count, and returns the array
